core_obligations: Define F(W) as the set of families (s_i) with s_i in F_i(W \cap U_i) satisfying varphi_{ij}(s_i|_{W \cap U_i \cap U_j}) = s_j|_{W \cap U_i \cap U_j}; restriction maps are componentwise, and the sheaf condition for F follows componentwise from the sheaf condition of the F_i (proof lines 5432-5446). For W \subset U_i the glueing-data commutativity forces s_j = varphi_{ij}(s_i|_{W \cap U_j}), and conversely any s in F_i(W) extends to a compatible family by setting s_i = s and s_j = varphi_{ij}(s_i|_{W \cap U_j}); hence F|_{U_i} \cong F_i and the required diagrams commute (proof lines 5448-5456).
proof_roadmap: Construct F as compatible families of sections and verify the sheaf condition componentwise (proof lines 5432-5446).
Identify F|_{U_i} with F_i via the forced form of compatible families and the glueing-data commutativity (proof lines 5448-5456).
